thread.title: Apple Inc. : (AAPL) Suppliers Gearing Up For Record Fall Shipments

author: www.4-traders.com
title: Apple Inc. : (AAPL) Suppliers Gearing Up For Record Fall Shipments
text:
Foreign-based companies that make the integral parts for Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) iPhones are reportedly getting ready for an extremely busy fall season.
9to5Mac has more details on the upcoming launch cycle, which should see several new models and sharply higher demand from consumers:
Although Apple is yet to announce its new models, or its event to announce the new models, the expectations are already high; three new models, an iPhone X successor, a new 6.5-inch iPhone X Plus and a mass market 6.1-inch LCD iPhone with thin bezels and Face ID just like the iPhone X.
Digitimes says that Apple suppliers are gearing up to ship the most new iPhones ever, fuelled by strong adoption of the ~$700 6.1-inch model, which will bring the best parts of the iPhone X to accessible price points.
Analysts believe Apple will look to boost unit sales this time around, amid flat shipment levels since the iPhone Xs introduction last November. That phones high cost has increased the average selling price (ASP), but with less people able to afford such an expensive device, which starts at $999 , shipments have flatlined.
Rumor has it the new phone lineup will start at $699 for a 6.1-inch iPhone (replacing the iPhone 8), a 5.8-inch iPhone X at $899 , and a larger 6.5-inch iPhone X at $999 .
Apple Inc. shares rose $0.29 (+0.13%) in premarket trading Wednesday. Year-to-date, AAPL has gained 31.31%, versus a 9.57% rise in the benchmark S&P 500 index during the same period.
AAPL currently has a StockNews.com POWR Rating of A (Strong Buy), and is ranked #1 of 28 stocks in the Technology Hardware category.
